name: PR detail Review runs card shows severity counters and filters findings by severity
description: HW1 criteria 16–18. From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab; the seeded review run's card is open by default, so under its verdict + PR SCORE the severity pills (1 CRITICAL · 1 WARNING) and the Critical / Warning / Suggestion filter buttons render. Clicking Critical keeps the CRITICAL finding; clicking it again restores the full list (the WARNING finding). Counts come from persisted findings — read-only seeded data, no model call. Hiding of non-matching cards is asserted by the RTL tests (FindingsPanel.test.tsx); the PR-list hover popover (criteria 20–21) by PRRow.test.tsx. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
